questions.stem: How are gibberellins used in the brewing industry?

options.text: To add flavour to the final product
To stimulate germination of barley seeds to produce malt for brewing
To speed up fermentation of alcohol
To preserve beer for longer periods

questions.explanation: Gibberellins are used in brewing to stimulate the germination of barley seeds. During germination, starch in the seeds is converted to sugars (malting), which are then fermented to produce alcohol.
